name: World editor
body:
# World editor

Lantern's level editor (`apps/world-editor`, guide in `docs/editor.md`). The front end is Nyx, Chaos and Cosmos on
Penumbra through penumbra-ui-backend; the logic and the 3D viewport are Rust (`crates/editor-core`,
`crates/editor-backend`) behind the C API in `crates/editor-backend/include/lantern_editor.h`. Decisions go in
`docs/decisions.md` (D-018 to D-022, then D-031 onwards for this round).

Each feature here is one slice of the editor. The UI stack's own gaps are filed on the owning repository's board
(penumbra, chaos, cosmos, penumbra-ui-backend, umbra-interfaces) and the Nyx-level ones on fearless-hq's Nyx board
under the `game-engine` epic (`GAME-F02`, `GAME-F03`).
